title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
summary: After a night of despair, Nora Seed finds herself in a library between life and death. Each book on its shelves is a different life she might have had, and she can try them one by one.
readIf: you want a warm, easy-to-read story about regret, choices and finding a reason to stay.
skipIf: you are sensitive to stories that begin with a suicide attempt, or want a rigorous take on parallel worlds.

pairings.reason: Another warm novel about a man or woman on the edge who finds reasons to continue.
A darker, more romantic fantasy about what it means to live many lives and be remembered.
A comic, tender novel that finds hope among people who feel they are failing.
